title: The AI Side Hustle Hiding on Main Street
style: Read this like a funny, honest, energetic friend in a quick social video. Playful on the joke, then clear and practical.

segments.title: Your favorite pizza shop hasn't posted since 2019.
segments.say: Your favorite pizza shop hasn't posted on Facebook since twenty nineteen. That's a side hustle sitting right there.

segments.title: Offer a month of posts
bullets: Ask the owner what's new and what sells
You edit, add real photos, they approve
segments.say: Ask the owner what's new and what sells. Use AI to draft twelve posts in a few minutes. Then you edit them, add real photos from the shop, and get the owner's okay before anything goes live. Charge a simple flat monthly fee. Start with one business you already know.

chat.user: Write 12 short Facebook posts for [Tony's Pizza] for this month. Specials: [$10 Tuesday large pie, new garlic knots]. Friendly, local, end each with a question.
chat.ai:
